project.description: Brownfield changes against the Metrolinx codelines, sourced from Jira — defects AND new features.
project.$scopeWhy: NO CODELINE SCOPE IS DECLARED HERE, deliberately. This carried outputDirs:[cdts] — a single codeline left over from an earlier run. pre-run-reset restores this file over prd.json at the start of EVERY run, and resolve-codeline-scope.sh exits before scanning anything when a scope is already declared, so discovery would never have run and every run would have been scoped to that one repository whatever the ticket said. Discovery fills this gap from the ticket; a project that genuinely owns a fixed scope declares it here and discovery correctly stands aside.
